question.text: Equation of common tangent of $y=x^2, y=-x^2+4 x-4$ is

solution.text:
The equation of tangent to $y=x^2$, be $y=m x-\frac{m^2}{4}$, putting in $y=-x^2+4 x-4$, we should only get one value of $x$ i.e. Discriminate must be zero.
$$
\begin{array}{rrr}
\therefore & m x-\frac{m^2}{4} & =-x^2+4 x-4 \\
\Rightarrow & x^2+x(m-4)+4-\frac{m^2}{4} & =0 \\
\Rightarrow & m(m-4) & =0 \\
& \therefore y=0 & \text { or } m=0,4
\end{array}
$$

$$
\therefore y=0 \text { and } y=4(x-1) \text { are tangents. }
$$
